metadata.headline: Colbert Suggests Unplugging the Government Then Turning It on Again
metadata.speaker: am

sentences.sentence: Welcome to Late Night Roundup, a rundown of the previous night’s highlights that lets you sleep — and lets us get paid to watch comedy.
Here are the 50 best movies on Netflix right now.
The U.S. government shut down for the first time since 2018 on Wednesday.
Stephen Colbert said he didn’t call this one, “but, evidently, ‘The Late Show’ has outlasted the United States federal government, because we’re still open, and they done shut down.”
